name: print-social-fitness-nutrition-posts-orange-to-blue-gradient-italic-caps
title: Fitness nutrition pack on orange-to-blue gradients with italic caps and blue label bars
whatItIs: Nine square posts on peach-orange to blue gradients with heavy italic uppercase headlines ('START TODAY', 'NEVER GIVE UP', 'TRAINING IS WELLNESS'), blue and orange label bars, X marks, dot grids and occasional photos of a woman training.
whatItMeans: Energetic and sporty; italic type leans forward like motion.
techniques: Use heavy italic caps to imply speed.
Put subheads in solid colour bars.
Blend a warm-to-cool gradient behind type.
Use X marks and dots as sporty ornaments.

vocabulary.definition: A solid bar behind a short line.
